name: Tesseract Cartesian Target
description: Build an exact native Tesseract CartesianTarget without converting geometry or units.

inputParameters.name: pose
inputParameters.description: Exact native Pose. WorkingFramePose retains its frame identity; a plain native Pose remains accepted without COMPAS reinterpretation.

inputParameters.name: move_type
inputParameters.description: Exact native move type: FREESPACE, LINEAR, or CIRCULAR. Defaults to FREESPACE.

inputParameters.name: profile
inputParameters.description: Exact non-empty Tesseract motion-profile name. Defaults to DEFAULT.

outputParameters.name: target
outputParameters.description: Exact native CartesianTarget retaining the input Pose and, when supplied, its working-frame identity.
